newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldovan special insurance bonds oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Moldovan special insurance bonds oversubscribed.

text.p: Moldova's Finance Ministry on Tuesday placed the first issue of special bonds designed to rebuild insurance deposits of private persons consumed by hyperinflation.
All of the two million lei one-year bonds were acquired by 11 dealer banks at a heavily oversubscribed auction with bids of 5.66 million lei, a National Bank official told Reuters.
"The first auction was a success, and we plan to place another 365-day issue worth four million lei on December 10," a Finance Ministry official told Reuters.
